title: Neko
description: Calm clinical luxury: a white page washed in soft lemon and pale ice blue, blue-tinted charcoal text, one clear cyan-blue for the join buttons, a deep navy closing strip. A soft display serif for every headline over a neutral humanist sans, 40px gutters and 200px breathers.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a night sibling (navy page, dim olive wash for the lemon)
Newsreader (display optical size) stands in for Orleans (closed); IBM Plex Sans is the original body face
secondary is the navy closing strip with white text, not a light surface
gutter and section padding scale with the window: 20px/100px on phones, 40px/200px at 1440
